limits: Perspective images cannot establish exact millimetre dimensions or prove every hidden furniture clearance. Geometry conclusion is visual and plan-based, not a measured survey. resolution_note: The three approved photo-based bathroom 2 images retain cropped source pixel dimensions: 1300x954, 1300x954 and 1366x1004. No minimum resolution was agreed.
